scope: Pinned RTC sleep, native configuration/FPU/error binding, SoftDevice NVIC critical state, RTC24-bit compare/delta/debug clamp, abort/zero/sleep, SVC error continuation, WFE branch and pending FPU FPSCR clear; ordered MMIO writes and registers
limitations: Sleep-status, tick-step, SD-enabled and error handlers are explicit lower fixtures. RTC two counter reads are controlled. SVC65 and WFE are explicit instruction fixtures, not physical wait/SoftDevice execution. Memory-backed MMIO write equality does not prove peripheral semantics or hardware wake.
